case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: All required components are available: clear objectives, quantified $1.24M savings (13% reduction), multiple category-level proof points, and documented approach.
case_study_packaging.headline: Faith-based e-commerce retailer captures $1.24M (13%) annual savings and 3.3x ROI through Treya-led strategic sourcing sprint
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Christianbook, LLC—a family-founded online and catalog retailer of Christian books and gifts—was managing nearly $18 million of indirect spend through long-standing, largely unchallenged supplier relationships. With new backing from Nonantum Capital Partners and an aggressive value-creation timeline, leadership needed to quickly unlock hard cost savings in freight, packaging, merchant processing and other categories while preserving service continuity during peak fulfillment seasons. Without a centralized procurement function, the company sought external expertise to drive data-driven negotiations and stand up scalable sourcing processes.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A leading faith-based e-commerce retailer was managing nearly $18 million of indirect spend through long-standing, largely unchallenged supplier relationships. With support from the private equity ownership group and an aggressive value-creation timeline, leadership needed to quickly unlock hard cost savings in freight, packaging, merchant processing and other categories while preserving service continuity during peak fulfillment seasons. Lacking a centralized procurement function, the company sought external expertise to drive data-driven negotiations and establish scalable sourcing processes.
approach_summary: Performed a rapid 12-month AP spend diagnostic to baseline $18 million across eight indirect categories and prioritize high-impact opportunities.
Ran data-rich competitive RFPs for merchant processing, corrugated, packaging supplies, LTL and FTL freight, injecting market tension and benchmarking every bid line.
Negotiated a switch from Chase Paymentech to Calibr Merchant Solutions, reducing net effective processing rates from 2.86% to 2.56% while ensuring seamless checkout migration.
Retained incumbent corrugated and packaging suppliers but leveraged multi-round pricing negotiations to secure double-digit discounts and new volume-based rebates.
Consolidated LTL and FTL transportation with Echo Logistics, capturing 31% freight savings and simplifying carrier management, all timed post-peak to avoid operational disruption.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $1,237,359 in fully executed annual savings—with an additional $30,291 in flight—equating to a 13% cost reduction across five categories and a 3.3× return on its $375K fixed project fee. Savings landed at the high end of the original estimate while preserving service quality, accelerating value realization in just 120 days, and laying the groundwork for a scalable, best-in-class procurement function.
where_we_were_unique: Achieved first live pricing reductions within four months of kick-off, well ahead of peak season.
Balanced cost take-out with operational continuity by retaining or seamlessly transitioning mission-critical suppliers.
Leveraged deep freight, payments and packaging category expertise to exceed the client’s high-end savings target.
Provided hands-on data collection and stakeholder coordination, filling resource gaps and establishing repeatable sourcing templates for future waves.
